cover.headline: 12 stories in 5 minutes. A deadly train crash in Spain, Israel's vote unresolved, the Fed holds.

stories.head: High-speed trains collide near Urda
body: At least 68 people died when a Renfe AVE hit a stationary Iryo train. A control centre had cleared the AVE despite a red signal.
The minister calls the order inexplicable. Spain declared three days of mourning.

stories.head: Israel: no bloc has a majority
body: With nearly 90% counted, Netanyahu's bloc is on course for 53 seats and Eisenkot's for 48. A majority needs 61.
Over 500,000 special ballots remain. Likud alleges fraud by Arab parties; no evidence has been shown.

stories.head: Fed holds, Bank of Canada hikes
body: The Fed held rates in a 10-2 vote as US inflation rose to 3.7%. The Bank of Canada raised its rate to 2.5%, its first hike since 2023.
The UK budget adds 100 pounds in energy help for 20 million households and cuts borrowing headroom to 15 billion.

stories.head: Abu Dhabi talks, Nord Stream, Iran
body: Zelensky hopes for US-Russia-Ukraine talks on Nov. 6 to 10. Brussels says Nord Stream will not reopen after the war.
Iran presses its seven-day Hormuz plan. Trump denies he ordered talks.
stories.sources: Sources: Kyiv Independent, Euronews, Al Jazeera

stories.head: Ebola, Belgrade, Seoul and Tokyo
body: Congo's Ebola outbreak passes 10,000 cases and 4,887 deaths. Serbia killed an attacker outside Israel's embassy.
South Korea fined Google and Apple about 42.7 million euros. A magnitude 5.4 quake shook Tokyo.
